title.suggested: Tom Allen's Free Concerts at 619 Market Street

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat carried a notice that Tom Allen, retired champion pugilist of the world, offered a free concert every evening at 619 Market Street, with only the very best singers engaged.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, July 16, 1898, page 7.

facts.fact: Allen's place at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, offered free concerts every evening; he was billed as retired champion pugilist of the world

notes: The Allen item is a short paid-style notice; it is entirely about him, so focus primary. Same notice ran in 977 and 978.
